eval_dimensions.name: Split Strategy Approval Gate
eval_dimensions.description: After proposing the split boundaries in Phase 1, the skill fires AskUserQuestion (Approve split plan / Adjust boundaries / Abort) before starting the interactive rebase that begins destructive history rewriting.

evals.name: Split strategy fires AskUserQuestion before rebase starts
evals.description: After analyzing the monolithic commit and proposing N split boundaries, the skill fires AskUserQuestion per the ask-split-strategy.md call spec before Phase 2's interactive rebase begins.

assertions.signal: AskUserQuestion fires with header 'Split Strategy' and options Approve/Adjust/Abort before 'git rebase -i' runs
No inline 'Proposed split into N commits. Approve?' text substitutes for the tool call
git rebase -i is not started until AskUserQuestion returns a response

evals.name: Adjust boundaries re-proposes a split plan
evals.description: Selecting 'Adjust boundaries' re-derives the split plan from the user's correction and re-fires the gate rather than proceeding with the original plan.

assertions.signal: No rebase starts with the original (unadjusted) boundaries; the gate re-fires after the plan is revised

evals.name: Abort leaves the original commit untouched
evals.description: Selecting 'Abort' stops the skill and leaves the monolithic commit as-is — no rebase or history rewrite occurs.

assertions.signal: No 'git reset', 'git rebase', or 'git commit-tree' call runs after Abort

trigger_evals.description: Queries that should/should-not trigger the git-commit-split skill

should_trigger.rationale: Direct invocation to split a monolithic commit into atomic commits

should_trigger.query: this commit is doing too much, split it into smaller ones
should_trigger.rationale: Split-commit intent — the core use case

should_not_trigger.query: create a new commit for these changes
should_not_trigger.rationale: Use dev10x:git-commit — there is nothing to split yet

should_not_trigger.query: clean up and reorder the commit history on this branch
should_not_trigger.rationale: Use dev10x:git-groom for broader history grooming
